oval.description: Oval is the most versatile face shape — most styles work well.

necklines.reason: Elongates while framing balanced proportions
Complements the natural curves of an oval face
Adds definition and structure attractively
Draws attention to the collarbone area beautifully

glasses.reason: Classic shape that works with oval's symmetry
Adds a fun angular contrast to soft features
Timeless and universally flattering for oval

hairstyles.reason: Clean lines complement the oval shape
Natural volume works well with oval's balance

earrings.reason: Oval faces can wear any hoop size
Simple and elegant for everyday wear

round.description: Round faces benefit from styles that add length and reduce width.

necklines.reason: Creates a vertical line that elongates the face
Adds length and draws the eye downward
Lengthens the appearance of a round face
Breaks the circular symmetry with interest

glasses.reason: Adds definition and contrast to soft curves
Square corners help elongate a round face
Upswept corners draw the eye upward and outward

hairstyles.reason: Creates length and slims the face
Adds height to elongate the face

earrings.reason: Elongate and slim the face visually
They echo and amplify the circular shape

square.description: Square faces benefit from soft curves to balance the strong jaw.

necklines.reason: Soft curves soften the angular jaw
Draws the eye inward and down, reducing jaw width emphasis
Curved shape balances a square jaw beautifully
Horizontal emphasis at shoulders balances the jaw

glasses.reason: Soft curves contrast and soften a strong jaw
Rounded bottom edge softens angular features
Minimal structure doesn't add more angles

hairstyles.reason: Organic curves counterbalance the jaw's angles
Softens the jaw with movement at that level

earrings.reason: Round shape softens the jaw line
Square earrings amplify the jaw's squareness

heart.description: Heart-shaped faces benefit from adding width at the jaw and reducing forehead emphasis.

necklines.reason: Wide neckline draws attention away from wide forehead
Adds visual width at the chin area to balance
Draped fabric minimizes the width difference
Emphasizes the narrow chin and wide forehead contrast

glasses.reason: Visual weight at the bottom balances wide forehead
Soft shape complements the pointed chin
Reduces visual emphasis on the wide forehead

hairstyles.reason: Builds visual width to balance the forehead
Adds width exactly where the face is narrowest
Reduces the apparent width of a wide forehead

earrings.reason: Add visual width at jaw level to balance

diamond.description: Diamond faces benefit from softening prominent cheekbones and adding width at forehead and chin.

necklines.reason: Adds width at the shoulders to balance wide cheeks
Horizontal line creates visual width at the top
Soft opening draws focus away from the cheekbones
Elongates and draws the eye down from cheekbones

glasses.reason: Accentuates the forehead and brow to add balance
Widens the appearance of the forehead
Adds definition at the brow area

hairstyles.reason: Adds width at the forehead to balance cheeks

earrings.reason: Don't add extra width at the widest cheek point
Draw attention down past wide cheekbones

long.description: Long faces benefit from styles that add width and reduce the appearance of length.

necklines.reason: Strong horizontal line visually shortens a long face
Wide opening adds visual width
Horizontal drape breaks the vertical line
Extend the vertical line making the face appear longer

glasses.reason: Circular shape breaks the long vertical
Draw the eye sideways rather than up and down

hairstyles.reason: Reduce visible face length from forehead to chin
Adds width to counterbalance the long face
Keeps the silhouette wide and short

earrings.reason: Add horizontal width at the ear
Extend visually sideways to balance face length
Amplify the vertical of the long face
